title: 第十九章 雷涅的打算第二十章 战凝神
lines: “雷道友此话是何用意？！”
那灵老头终是在经过初始的震惊失态后，将心神彻底的收敛而回。
旋即抬首，仔细的打量起，雷涅脸上于此刻摆出一股难以言表的异常微笑。
在略做沉吟后，随即蕴声问道。
“灵道友，就莫要装糊涂了！”
对于灵青圣的问话，雷涅只是在言谈间加注了一翻暗示，以此做为某种另有其意的思绪导向。
让其思维下意识的往“这雷涅知道此间事情另有隐秘，只是不知道到底是以何种方法解决“的方向上靠拢。
雷涅之所以说出，如此暗含深意的回复。
其目的就是要搏上一搏！
看看能否让这灵老头在恍惚中，抖露出一些雷涅根本丝毫不知的信息出来！
雷涅还是低估了这老怪的老炼与狡猾程度。
其只是眉头急跳了几下，双眼迸射出一道，仿若可以凝成实质的精芒。
让得不远处正观察，其在听闻自己言谈后，会做出何种举动的雷涅，心下都是于猛然间，震动而起，险些被其于骇然间流露而出的压迫，侵蚀心神，丢了方寸！
虽然雷涅心中变化可谓是翻江倒海，但其面庞依旧是于从容间，淡然微笑。
在瞧得雷涅脸上那略显僵硬的笑容，灵老头却是自刹那间，也在脸上涌出一抹诡异微笑！
随即微微轻转了几次脖颈，一直手掌搭于双肩中心处的脊梁之首，伴随着略显缓慢的揉搓，上下嘴唇闭合间，一道淡漠言语从其口中缓缓传出。
“雷道友不必在试探老夫了，以道友的机敏能猜到此点也算正常，不过在回答道友这个问题之前，我想道友应该会给我一个满意的回答吧。”
雷涅双眼微眯成一道细缝，表露出，其心中的那股忐忑，总算于灵老头肯定了自己心中所想后，彻底的放了下来。
“此事还真有可以避重就轻的解决之道！”
“想来自己猜的没错，这灵老怪若不是此次，不知因何原因看重了我这艘玄天战舟，这才想到通过那所谓的抵押手段，将其得到。”
“若是没了此舟做饵，那么这老怪断然不会拿出两件法宝来做为押注筹码的！”
“所以管中窥豹，若是以往，那些六派的带队长老拿不出来，可以做为筹码的法宝，必然得有某种办法，来解决此间之事。”
“凭自己与这化圣门老怪接触的这段时间，自己便能直接断定，若想从身为三巨宗长老的老怪手中，借法宝，做筹码，那简直是难如登天！”
“那最终……留给这名六派长老的选择也只有一个，那便是退出双国争斗，只不过，用脚趾头想都会想到，若要退出此间争斗，必然还得有什么附加条件才行！”
“而他雷涅，问的便是这个所谓的附加条件，到底指的是何物？！”
“或者……何事？！”
雷涅心下腹诽间，却是将这此间种种，想了个通透。
而至于这灵青圣口中，想要的那份答复，雷涅能将此之一事，推演到如此境地。
又如何不知其到底想要自己做以何种答复！
只见雷涅嘴唇微一一张，一道带有清朗笑声的言语，自其嗓间，震荡而出。
传将进灵老怪的双耳之中。
“灵道友不必如此紧张，我那玄天战舟现在已经在道友手中，算是我与道友结个善缘，此物就先借道友使用一二，等道友把要凭此物办的事办完，再将其交还于我！”
听闻此间言语，那灵青圣略微皱起的眉头，终是于此一刻，释然而开。
随即缓缓点头，欣然轻言说道：“果然雷道友智慧绝非常人，凭此间蛛丝马迹就能推断出老夫心中所想，到是灵某先前作态，有些让雷道友见笑了。”
其实要是观得此间隐秘到也并非什么难事，区区一件法器，竟能让得一名化丹境强者甘愿冒着多损失一件法宝的风险，也要强行将之留住。
那只能说明，此件法器是这名化丹境修士为了了结某事，必要之物！
content_en:
"What is the purpose of Fellow Daoist Lei's words?!"
The old man Ling finally calmed down and returned after the initial shock.
Immediately he raised his head and looked at it carefully. At this moment, Rene had an unusual smile on his face that was hard to describe.
After thinking for a while, Yun Sheng asked.
"Fellow Daoist Ling, please stop pretending to be confused!"
Regarding Lingqing Sheng's question, Rene just added some hints in his words, using it as a guide to some other thoughts.
Let his thoughts subconsciously move closer to the direction of "Rene knows that there is another secret to the matter here, but he just doesn't know how to solve it."
The reason why Rene said such a profound reply was.
The purpose is to give it a try!
Let's see if we can get this old man to reveal some information that Rene doesn't even know about in his trance!
But...
Rene still underestimated the sophistication and cunningness of this old monster.
His brows only twitched a few times, and his eyes shot out, as if they could condense into a real light.
Rene, who was not far away and was watching what kind of actions he would make after hearing what he said, was suddenly shaken in his heart. He was almost lost by the oppression revealed in his shock, which eroded his mind and made him lose his mind!
Although the changes in Reine's heart could be described as overwhelming, his face was still calm and smiling calmly.
Seeing the slightly stiff smile on Rene's face, Old Man Ling suddenly had a strange smile on his face!
Then he turned his neck slightly a few times, until his palms were placed on the top of the spine in the center of his shoulders. With a slightly slow rubbing, an indifferent word slowly came out of his mouth while his upper and lower lips were closed.
"Fellow Daoist Lei, there is no need to test me. It is normal for you to guess this with your astuteness. However, before answering this question, I think you should give me a satisfactory answer."
Reine's eyes narrowed into a thin slit, revealing that the anxiety in his heart was finally completely relieved after the old man Yu Ling confirmed what he was thinking.
"There really is a way to solve this problem that can avoid the major issues!"
"I think my guess was right. If it hadn't been for this time, this old monster would have valued my Xuantian battle boat for some unknown reason, and then he thought of getting it through the so-called mortgage method."
"If there is no bait for this boat, then this old monster will definitely not take out two magic weapons as betting chips!"
"So, if we can only see the leopard in the past, the leaders of the six sects cannot come up with magic weapons that can be used as bargaining chips, there must be some way to solve the matter here."
"Based on the period of time I have been in contact with this old monster of the Transformation Saint Sect, I can directly conclude that if I want to borrow a magic weapon from the old monster who is the elder of the Three Giant Sects and use it as a bargaining chip, it will be as difficult as heaven!"
"In the end... there is only one choice left for this elder of the six sects, and that is to withdraw from the battle between the two countries. However, if you think about it with your toes, you will think that if you want to withdraw from the battle here, there must be some additional conditions!"
"And he, Rene, asked what this so-called additional condition refers to?!"
"Or...what's the matter?!"
Renie was cursing in his heart, but he thought through all the things here.
As for the answer that Lingqing Saint wanted, Rene was able to deduce this matter to such a situation.
How come I don’t know what kind of answer he wants to give himself!
Rene's lips opened slightly, and words with clear laughter came out from his throat.
The message will enter the ears of the old monster Ling.
"Fellow Taoist Ling, you don't have to be so nervous. My Xuantian war boat is now in the hands of fellow Taoist. It can be regarded as a good relationship between me and fellow Taoist. I will borrow this thing from you for a while, and then return it to me after you finish what you need to do with it!"
After hearing the words here, the slightly frowned brows of Ling Qingsheng finally relaxed at this moment.
Then he nodded slowly and said softly with pleasure: "Sure enough, Fellow Daoist Lei is very intelligent. You can deduce what I am thinking based on the clues here. It is Ling's previous behavior that made Fellow Daoist Lei laugh."
In fact, it is not difficult to see that this place is so secretive. A mere magic weapon can actually make a strong man in the elixir realm willing to risk losing another magic weapon and forcefully keep it.
That can only mean that this magic weapon is necessary for this alchemy realm monk to solve something!
